### Basiq, the Simple Choice in High Quality, Value Priced Power Supplies

Building on a budget doesn't mean you have to trust your components to an un-reliable, no-name brand. That's why Antec put its years of experience and knowledge into building world-class power supplies and the result is Basiq. The workhorse of the Antec family, Basiq is built with solid quality you have come to expect from Antec products at an unbeatable price. It does the job simply, efficiently and reliably, making Basiq a solid power supply built to satisfy the demands from the entry-level power user to the budget minded system builder.

- Weight: 3.7lbs

- Universal Input with Active PFC

# Antec Basiq BP500U 500 Watt Power Supply

$60.00

In Stock • 9 units

The Antec Basiq BP500U is a 500W ATX12V Power Supply designed for stable power delivery with 80 PLUS efficiency and Active PFC technology. It features an 80mm quiet cooling fan and comprehensive protection mechanisms including Over Voltage Protection (OVP), Short Circuit Protection (SCP), and Over Power Protection (OPP). It is certified by UL, CB, CE, CSA, TUV, and FCC. Connectivity includes a 20+4-pin main connector, 4+4-pin ATX12V/EPS12V, PCI-E 6-pin, SATA, Molex, and a floppy connector. Note: This product is listed as discontinued by some sources.
